title: The Good Samaritan
description: A lawyer asks Jesus who his neighbor is. Jesus tells of a man who was attacked by robbers on the way from Jerusalem to Jericho. A priest and a Levite passed by on the other side, but a Samaritan felt compassion, bound up his wounds, brought him to an inn, and paid for his care. Jesus asks who was the victim's neighbor and urges the lawyer to do likewise.

versions.title: The Good Samaritan
versions.description: A Samaritan helps an injured man whom a priest and a Levite passed by. Jesus asks: "Who was a neighbor to the one who fell among robbers?"
